messages.content: Can you help me get comments on a domain youtube.com on VirusTotal? My key is my_api. Set the limit to 10 and the continuation cursor to abc.

message.reasoning:

We need to call the function get_comments_on_domain with arguments:

{
    "api_key": "my_api",
    "domain": "youtube.com",
    "limit": 10,
    "continuation_cursor": "abc"
}
